```yaml
name: Secrets Diagnostics

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  secrets-diagnostics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: go mod download

    - name: Extend token precedence chain
      run: |
        # Extend token precedence chain in getEffectiveAgentGitHubToken function
        sed -i 's|return os.Getenv("GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN")|return getFallbackToken(os.Getenv("GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN"))|' path/to/getEffectiveAgentGitHubToken.go

    - name: Update callers to pass full token chain
      run: |
        # Update safe_outputs_steps.go
        sed -i 's|safeOutputsStep := &SafeOutputsStep{...}|safeOutputsStep := &SafeOutputsStep{Tokens: []string{os.Getenv("GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN")}, ...}|' path/to/safe_outputs_steps.go

        # Update safe_outputs_env.go
        sed -i 's|env := map[string]string{...}|env := map[string]string{"TOKENS": strings.Join([]string{os.Getenv("GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN")}, ",")}|' path/to/safe_outputs_env.go

        # Update copilot_participant_steps.go
        sed -i 's|participantSteps := &ParticipantSteps{...}|participantSteps := &ParticipantSteps{Tokens: []string{os.Getenv("GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN")}, ...}|' path/to/copilot_participant_steps.go

        # Update create_issue.go
        sed -i 's|issueStep := &IssueStep{...}|issueStep := &IssueStep{Tokens: []string{os.Getenv("GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN")}, ...}|' path/to/create_issue.go

    - name: Recompile campaign-generator.lock.yml
      run: go build -o campaign-generator path/to/campaign-generator.go

    - name: Test changes
      run: ./campaign-generator --test
```
